capSemanticsReview.rationale: Pinned ethereum block 26113624 (hash 0xa8237b00d3c3b45acd6b8c3284c68a98037052ea7447b7674ce460b207a33ca2). The pinned sGho implementation inherits ERC4626 _deposit, which safeTransferFroms GHO before _mint. supplyCap and rate parameters change deposit capacity/share conversion, not discretionary issuance to a chosen recipient without asset funding. The Aave Level-1 Executor ProxyAdmin upgrade power can replace this construction but is upgrade-only, not a new D14 mint trigger; the currently verified local mint path remains GHO-deposit backed. Inherited controls concern gho-aave, whose parent issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency, not wrapper-local D14.

mintAuthority.summary: sGHO is a savings wrapper over GHO; wrapper minting is share accounting while durable GHO mint authority is inherited from reviewed Aave facilitator controls.

noLocalIssuance.rationale: sGHO is the ERC-4626 receipt for GHO deposits, confirmed by asset() at Ethereum block 26095797 and the verified implementation. Wrapper shares do not issue native GHO liabilities; native issuance authority is inherited from gho-aave. The local governance upgrade path remains recorded separately.
